property_summary: For any callee address and calldata, the reference contract returns ok==true exactly when the low-level call to callee succeeds; the mutant inverts this check so for some callee (one that reverts) the mutant yields ok==true while the reference yields ok==false, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Change require(_s) to require(!_s) so the function reverts when the call succeeds and continues when it fails.
